This market will resolve according to the player that records the most kills on any single map played during VALORANT Champions 2026 (also known as VCT Champions 2026), currently scheduled for September 24 to October 18, 2026, in Shanghai, China.

Overtime rounds will be counted for the purposes of this market. Only completed maps count.

If two or more players are tied for the most kills on a single map, this market will resolve to the player with the higher ACS (Average Combat Score) on the map on which they recorded that kill total. If a tie persists, this market will resolve to the player with the lower deaths on said map. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve to the player whose listed in-game name comes first alphabetically.

If a player not listed in this market records the most kills on a single map, this market will resolve to "Other".

If VALORANT Champions 2026 is canceled, or is postponed such that it has not concluded by November 17, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market will be the vlr.gg event stats page (https://www.vlr.gg/event/stats/2766/valorant-champions-2026), using the KMax (most kills in a single map) column. However, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
